summary: Home page that asks the backend for saved financial models and shows each one as a card.
purpose: Lets the user see their saved models and start a new one.
why: Likely reason: a quick overview of saved work on the first screen.
how: When the page opens, it requests the model list from the backend at port 8000. It stores the list and shows a card for each model with its name, currency and period. A button leads to the wizard page.
inputs: The backend list of models at the models endpoint on localhost port 8000.
outputs: Model cards on the page. A failed request is printed to the console.
risks: The backend address is fixed to localhost port 8000, so it fails elsewhere. If the backend returns an error in JSON form instead of a list, the card display can break. The period end year is start year plus horizon years; whether that is off by one depends on the backend convention, which is unclear from this file.
debug: If the list is empty, confirm the backend is running on port 8000 and check the console for the error message about fetching models. If cards show blanks, compare the returned fields with the Model type.
